notes: Playback no longer stops a second or two after you press play. The cause was the app’s own audio-focus helper: this app’s sound comes from a WebView, the WebView holds audio focus for it, and asking for focus on the app’s behalf took that focus away from our own player — and the WebView’s answer to losing focus is to pause the song. The app never takes audio focus for itself any more, so nothing can pause it that way

If anything else ever pauses the song in its opening seconds, it is put straight back and never reaches the screen — up to three times, never within 700 ms of each other — and what happened is recorded on the device so it can be read back instead of guessed at
A waiting app update still cannot be applied from a pause you did not make, so a one-second hiccup can no longer turn into a mid-song reload
Interruptions still work: if the system does send one (a call taking over), playback pauses and comes straight back when focus returns
Album song reordering keeps its three-second hold, with the row filling as you hold it
